forms.name: Surface/apparatus split branch lattice

forms.name: Selector-vector branch lattice
forms.verification: branch packet + renderer + selector map + selector vector + unselected-final-word shadow claim + same-turn judgment firewall

forms.name: Lossy selector-vector branch lattice
forms.verification: branch packet + renderer + selector map + selector vector + unselected-final-word shadow claim + loss-budget receipt + same-turn judgment firewall
forms.risk: surface may become too slight; loss budget may hide rather than solve weak poetic pressure

forms.name: Glitch state-switch branch lattice
forms.verification: branch packet + renderer + selector map + selector vector + state-switch receipt + loss budget + same-turn judgment firewall
forms.risk: state switching may simply repackage the receipt unless the open state changes reading pressure

forms.name: Ergodic traverse state-switch branch lattice
forms.description: Selected branch-line endings determine a route through omitted candidates, while selector-vector and state-switch receipts preserve addressability and branch-loss transforms.

forms.name: Recursive zero-route state-switch branch lattice
forms.description: A selected branch path is also a deterministic route machine: every selected final word has length divisible by omitted-candidate count, forcing route index 0 and yielding a recursive command sentence from omitted candidates.
forms.risk: zero-route arithmetic may feel arbitrary unless rereading actually changes the object.

forms.name: Return-diff state-switch branch lattice
forms.description: A branch-lattice/state-switch draft that treats a previous traversal instruction as a required handoff: the new draft must verify that its selected surface differs from the previous surface and routes to a changed-return sentence.
forms.risk: Return-diff may prove local change while still failing as poetry; the diff can become another elegant receipt layer.

forms.name: Applied patch state-switch branch lattice
forms.description: Selected endings route through omitted candidates to produce route words; those route words are then applied as replacements against the selected surface and verified by a patch-application receipt.
forms.verification: branch selector + selector map/vector + loss budget + state switch + ergodic traversal + return diff + patch application
forms.risk: formal mutation may be trivial or aesthetically inert

forms.name: Reader-facing state object
forms.description: A reader-facing view that presents closed, open, traversal, and patched states as one accessible object with receipt-backed transitions.
forms.risk: May reveal that the P0001 machinery is more interesting as an audit trail than as a reading experience.
forms.non_claim: Implementation validates state traceability only, not literary quality.

forms.name: External material pressure fork
forms.description: A poem is forked around a resistant external source/object/place/measurement; exact source facts constrain visible draft language before additional machinery is added.
forms.non_claim: A recommendation, not a completed form.
forms.risk: External material can still become decoration; the first validator checks pressure and disclosure only, not quality.

forms.name: Disclosed-reader candidate packet
forms.description: A candidate-level reader packet that puts machine/source/runtime disclosure before the poem while separating hostile evaluator failure labels until after first response.
forms.risk: Packet readiness can be mistaken for reader evidence; validator allows real non-identifying responses but blocks admission/evidence leakage and pre-poem failure priming.
forms.non_claim: Form validates packet readiness only, not poem quality or reader response.

forms.name: Disclosed reader response intake
forms.verification: reader-only handoff ZIP + non-identifying duplicate-guarded JSON ingest gate
forms.risk: handoff/intake readiness may be mistaken for reader evidence; duplicate/blank/PII-bearing responses must be rejected
